<USER_REQUEST>
READ-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC — SATELLITE CATALOG vs BASELINE/PROCESSING DATA CONSISTENCY

There is now a data consistency issue visible in the UI.

Screenshot observations:

SATELLITE CATALOG:
- Sirumalai selected.
- Only 2 records are displayed.
- Both are SAR / Sentinel-1.
- Both show PROCESSED.

BASELINES & PROCESSING:
- Sirumalai selected.
- Sensor Family Track = SAR.
- 2 SAR baseline records are displayed.
- Dates shown include 1/6/2026 and 1/1/2021.
- One expected historical acquisition appears to be missing/mismatched.
- The End-to-End Pipeline Execution panel shows:
  CHECK 7 FAILED: No Google Drive ID recorded
  CHECK 8 FAILED: Drive file size undefined
  CHECK 9 FAILED: No local raster path recorded
  CHECK 10 FAILED: Raster has not been validated
  CHECK 11 FAILED: Raster band count undefined

DO NOT MODIFY CODE.
DO NOT MODIFY DATABASE.
DO NOT DELETE, RESET, SEED, OR RECREATE ANY RECORDS.

Perform a complete READ-ONLY data lineage audit.

GOAL:
Determine exactly why Satellite Catalog and Baselines & Processing are not showing/using the same acquired satellite observations.

Trace:

SatelliteMetadata
        ↓
Satellite Catalog
        ↓
Baseline candidate query
        ↓
Baseline record
        ↓
SatelliteMetadata reference
        ↓
Export metadata
        ↓
Google Drive file
        ↓
Local raster
        ↓
Raster validation
        ↓
14-gate baseline activation

1. SATELLITE METADATA AUDIT

For Sirumalai zone:
- list every SatelliteMetadata record associated with the zone.
- Include:
  _id
  imageId
  sensorType
  source
  acquisitionDate
  processingStatus
  zone/intersectingZones
  geeExportTaskId
  driveFileId
  driveFileName
  driveFileSize
  localRasterPath
  rasterValidated
  rasterBandCount
  rasterCrs
  rasterWidth
  rasterHeight
  rasterResolution
  createdAt
  updatedAt

Do NOT assume `zoneId` is the relationship if the schema uses `intersectingZones`.

2. CATALOG QUERY AUDIT

Inspect the exact repository/service query used by Satellite Catalog.

Determine:
- Why only 2 records are displayed.
- What filters are applied.
- Whether sensorType, zone, processingStatus, date range, pagination, or intersectingZones filters exclude other real records.
- Compare database records against the records returned by the catalog API.

3. BASELINE QUERY AUDIT

Inspect the exact query used by Baselines & Processing.

Determine:
- Which SatelliteMetadata records produced the 2 displayed SAR baseline candidates.
- Their exact imageIds.
- Their exact acquisition dates.
- Their SatelliteMetadata IDs.

Do not rely only on UI dates.

4. RELATIONSHIP AUDIT

For every SAR baseline candidate:

Baseline
→ satelliteMetadataId
→ SatelliteMetadata

Verify that the referenced SatelliteMetadata actually exists.

Report orphaned or mismatched references.

5. DATE / IMAGE ID AUDIT

The UI currently shows:
- 1/6/2026
- 1/1/2021

But an earlier test involved a 2020 Sentinel-1 acquisition.

Determine from the actual database:
- whether a 2020 observation exists,
- whether a 2021 observation exists,
- exact imageId for each,
- exact acquisition timestamp,
- whether the UI date is correctly derived from acquisitionDate.

Do NOT change dates.

6. EXPORT / RASTER AUDIT

For each Sirumalai SAR SatelliteMetadata record that is `PROCESSED`, verify:

GEE task ID
→ GEE task completion
→ Drive file ID
→ Drive file exists
→ Drive file size
→ local raster path
→ local file exists
→ GeoTIFF dimensions
→ band count
→ CRS
→ resolution
→ rasterValidated

Identify exactly which fields are missing.

IMPORTANT:
A record marked PROCESSED but missing Drive ID/local raster/rasterValidated is a data-integrity problem. Do not automatically repair it yet.

7. BASELINE 14-GATE AUDIT

For each displayed SAR candidate, report:

CHECK 1 Metadata exists
CHECK 2 Real GEE asset ID
CHECK 3 Acquisition date valid
CHECK 4 Supported sensor
CHECK 5 GEE export task ID
CHECK 6 Export completed
CHECK 7 Drive file ID
CHECK 8 Drive file size
CHECK 9 Local raster path
CHECK 10 rasterValidated
CHECK 11 rasterBandCount
CHECK 12 width/height
CHECK 13 CRS
CHECK 14 spectralIndicesCalculated / SAR equivalent

Clearly identify which checks pass/fail for each candidate.

8. IMPORTANT ARCHITECTURE CHECK

Determine whether the Satellite Catalog is supposed to show:
- all acquired SatelliteMetadata records,
or
- only records meeting a particular processing status.

Determine whether Baselines & Processing is intentionally showing a different dataset or whether both screens should reference the same SatelliteMetadata records.

9. DATABASE SAFETY

Record current counts before inspection and verify no changes occurred.

Production Vadipatti must remain untouched:
- Optical enabled
- SAR disabled
- existing Optical baseline unchanged
- existing ChangeDetection unchanged
- existing Alert unchanged

FINAL REPORT ONLY:

A. Sirumalai SatelliteMetadata records found
B. Records shown in Satellite Catalog
C. Records shown in Baselines & Processing
D. Exact mismatches
E. Missing/orphaned references
F. Missing export/raster fields
G. 14-gate results for each SAR candidate
H. Root cause
I. Minimal fix recommendation

DO NOT IMPLEMENT THE FIX YET.
STOP AFTER THE READ-ONLY AUDIT.
</USER_REQUEST>
